OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector.

NAMESHIELD_AUTH_BEARER.description: Bearer token of the NameShield API. The IP address of the connector must also be allowed on the NameShield side.

NAMESHIELD_SERVER.description: NameShield API server, used as `{server}` in the URL templates.

NAMESHIELD_API_VERSION.description: NameShield API version, used as `{api_version}` in the URL templates.

NAMESHIELD_API_ENDPOINT.description: NameShield API endpoint, used as `{api_endpoint}` in the URL templates.

NAMESHIELD_URL_LIST.description: URL template of the domain list. Supports the `{server}`, `{api_endpoint}` and `{api_version}` placeholders.

NAMESHIELD_URL_DOMAIN.description: URL template of the domain details. Supports the `{server}`, `{api_endpoint}`, `{api_version}` and `{domain}` placeholders.

NAMESHIELD_DOMAIN_LIMIT.description: Maximum number of domains imported per run.

NAMESHIELD_MARKING.description: TLP marking applied to the imported objects: `TLP:CLEAR`, `TLP:WHITE`, `TLP:GREEN`, `TLP:AMBER`, `TLP:AMBER+STRICT` or `TLP:RED`. Any other value falls back to `TLP:AMBER+STRICT`.

NAMESHIELD_LINK_TO_IDENTITIES.description: Comma-separated STIX IDs of identities (for example your organization) the indicators are attributed to. Leave empty to create no link.
